summary: Phase 17 backend verification: shorter suggestions + daily cap reduced to 25. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_phase17_shorter_and_cap.py (4 tests). Results: 3 passed, 1 skipped (429 enforcement skipped because neither seeded user is currently at cap — covered by summary math). daily_limit==25 confirmed for both User A and User B via GET /api/ai/usage/summary, proving env cap AI_DAILY_REQUEST_LIMIT=25 correctly wins over the entitlement value 100 in _resolve_daily_limit. Made exactly ONE real /api/ai/suggestion call (cost control): returned 200 with suggestion length within 400 chars and reason length within 300 chars, confirming the shorter-suggestion prompt + JSON schema caps are in effect. used_today/remaining math is consistent (remaining == max(0, daily_limit - used_today), never negative).
critical_code_review_comments: _resolve_daily_limit correctly applies stricter-wins: min(env_cap, entitlement) when both are >0, falling back to whichever is set — matches the spec.

usage_summary() only counts request_type=='suggestion' (excludes fallbacks) against the limit; enforcement in create_suggestion() also queries request_type=eq.suggestion, so counting is consistent end-to-end.
AISuggestion JSON schema maxLength suggestion=400, why=300 combined with the UNO_WORD_COACH_SYSTEM_PROMPT brevity instruction (<=2 short sentences) produced a compliant response in the live call.
